summary: HEICO Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of two tranches of senior unsecured notes due 20XX. The filing discloses aggregate principal amounts and interest rates as blanks, with semiannual interest payments and optional redemption features including a par call date. The notes are new issuances with no established trading market and will not be listed on any exchange. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Underwriters include Truist, BofA, PNC, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
